E1232

A monorepo source could not be fetched.

What

A monorepo source could not be fetched.

Why

Resolving a monorepo package fetches the source's workspace index and materializes only the addressed subtree; both the sparse subtree checkout and the full-clone fallback failed (D-MONOREF1).

Fix

check the source URL/rev and network access; if the provider lacks partial-clone support the full clone should still work, so this usually means the rev or repo is unreachable.
